fields.Participants: LR Director, Legal, HR, DOLE, Union
fields.Trigger: Petition for certification election or voluntary recognition request

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates the petitioner's legitimate-labor-organization status" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "files with the DOLE Regional Office (Med-Arbiter" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-481 (ensure controlled execution — Union Recognition, CBA Negotiation & Administration (PA-84.1).)
- operational: strict legal process and neutrality
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Unfair labor practice (ULP) charge for interference; mitigated by strict legal process and neutrality
System Touchpoints: - Labor relations case file; DOLE Regional Office / Bureau of Labor Relations records; bargaining-unit roster

steps.activity: LR Director receives petition for certification election or voluntary recognition request; validates the petitioner's legitimate-labor-organization status and bargaining-unit definition (a petition by an LLO is automatically ordered conducted per RA 9481 — no minimum support showing)
LR Director/Legal files with the DOLE Regional Office (Med-Arbiter, per D.O. 40-03) for certification election; participates in pre-election conference; mediates bargaining-unit definition
HR conducts certification election (with DOLE); notifies results; recognizes certified union as exclusive bargaining representative upon majority vote

fields.Participants: LR Director, Finance, HR, Legal, Management Panel

workflows.name: CBA Negotiation Preparation, Data Assembly & Bargaining Strategy

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "reviews prior CBA, grievances, and labor market benchmarks" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-generate of "prepares costing model for union proposals" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approves bargaining mandate, reservation points, and strike contingency plan" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: rigorous costing and mandate clarity
Pain Points / Risks: - **Negotiation risk**: Inadequate preparation concedes value; mitigated by rigorous costing and mandate clarity
System Touchpoints: - CBA costing model; labor-market benchmark; bargaining mandate record

steps.activity: LR Director assembles negotiation team (management panel); reviews prior CBA, grievances, and labor market benchmarks
Finance prepares costing model for union proposals: wage increase, benefits, allowances, incentive plan; estimates 5-year financial impact
Management approves bargaining mandate, reservation points, and strike contingency plan; LR Director finalizes strategy

fields.Participants: LR Director, Management Panel, Union Panel, DOLE Conciliator

workflows.name: CBA Negotiation Sessions, Deadlock Management & DOLE Conciliation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "conducts bargaining sessions per Labor Code" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "files notice of strike/lockout or submits to DOLE conciliation" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-481 (ensure controlled execution — Union Recognition, CBA Negotiation & Administration (PA-84.1).)
- operational: good-faith bargaining and contingency planning
Pain Points / Risks: - **Operational risk**: Strike disrupts retail operations; mitigated by good-faith bargaining and contingency planning
System Touchpoints: - Negotiation session record; DOLE conciliation case file; BCM continuity plan

steps.activity: LR Director conducts bargaining sessions per Labor Code (meets within 30 days of notice); bargains in good faith; documents positions
On deadlock, LR Director files notice of strike/lockout or submits to DOLE conciliation; participates in preventive mediation
Management executes contingency plan (operations continuity, temporary staffing, security) during impasse; seeks resolution before strike deadline

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "reviews for legal compliance and consistency with company policy and Labor" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-register of "registers CBA with DOLE Regional Office within 5 days of signing" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Unregistered CBA lacks enforceability; mitigated by 5-day registration discipline
System Touchpoints: - CBA repository; DOLE CBA registration portal; employee communication

steps.activity: Legal/LR Director drafts CBA text from agreed terms; reviews for legal compliance and consistency with company policy and Labor Code
Union ratifies CBA with membership vote; LR Director verifies ratification; both parties sign
LR Director registers CBA with DOLE Regional Office within 5 days of signing; publishes for employees; archives executed copy

workflows.name: CBA Implementation, Wage/Benefit Administration & Compliance Tracking

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "tracks compliance with each CBA article" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documents agreed interpretations as CBA side-agreements" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Non-implementation invites ULP/grievance; mitigated by implementation audit
System Touchpoints: - Payroll/HR CBA configuration; compliance tracker; side-agreement repository

steps.activity: HR/Payroll implements CBA provisions: wage scales, step increases, allowances, incentives, leave, benefits in payroll and HR systems
HR tracks compliance with each CBA article (grievance procedure, union rights, no-retaliation, security of tenure); audits implementation
LR Director monitors compliance exceptions; resolves disputes over interpretation; documents agreed interpretations as CBA side-agreements

workflows.name: CBA Economic Impact Modeling, Costing & Mid-Term Review

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "tracks actual CBA cost vs." (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review with union per reopener clause" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports impact to Executive Committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-481 (ensure controlled execution — Union Recognition, CBA Negotiation & Administration (PA-84.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost risk**: Unbudgeted CBA costs strain margin; mitigated by tracking and scenario modeling
System Touchpoints: - CBA costing/actual model; labor-market benchmark; scenario planning

steps.activity: Finance tracks actual CBA cost vs. costing model; analyzes variance; updates labor-cost forecast
HR/LR Director conducts mid-term review with union per reopener clause; benchmarks wages vs. industry and inflation
Finance models reopener economic scenarios; supports negotiation mandate; reports impact to Executive Committee

fields.Participants: Payroll, HR, Union, LR Director, VP Legal & Compliance

workflows.name: Union Dues Check-Off, Agency Fee & Authorization Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records per Labor Code requirements" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "Payroll deducts union dues/agency fee per authorization" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles remittance with union" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Non-remission or unauthorized deduction; mitigated by authorization discipline and reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - Check-off authorization records; payroll deduction; remittance reconciliation

steps.activity: HR captures employee check-off authorization (written, revocable); maintains authorization records per Labor Code requirements
Payroll deducts union dues/agency fee per authorization; remits to union within timeframe prescribed by law/CBA; reports remittance
LR Director reconciles remittance with union; resolves disputes; audits authorization currency annually

fields.Participants: LR Director, HR, Management Reps, Union Reps

workflows.name: Labor-Management Council (LMC) Charter & Joint Governance Operations

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "LMC convenes quarterly" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks action items" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-481 (ensure controlled execution — Union Recognition, CBA Negotiation & Administration (PA-84.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Engagement risk**: LMC becomes ceremonial; mitigated by action-item accountability
System Touchpoints: - LMC charter repository; meeting minutes; action-item tracker

steps.activity: LR Director charters LMC with union: composition, meeting cadence, agenda scope (productivity, quality, welfare, communication)
LMC convenes quarterly; discusses operational improvements, employee concerns, and joint initiatives; documents minutes
LR Director tracks action items; reports LMC outcomes and partnership health to Executive Committee
